_note: Hand-maintained data, not code. Add real Zenodo URLs as per-category and per-country archives are published. GET /api/raw-data/links returns this file as-is. Keys in byCategory must match the category values in metadata.csv exactly (e.g. 'dairy', 'alcohol'); keys in byCountry must match the ISO3 country codes (e.g. 'TUR', 'USA'). Omit a key entirely when there is no link yet — an empty string renders as a clickable but broken link.
